item.title: Geraldton water polo round 8: Serpents A-grade women fall one goal short of taking it up to top team Demons
item.description: Serpents came within a whisker of upsetting ladder leaders Demons in a thrilling women’s A-grade contest, falling a goal short in one of the best matches of the season so far.

item.title: Family of Geraldton man Mark Beaver pay tribute to character with ‘heart of gold’ after alleged fatal assault
item.description: The family of Geraldton man Mark Beaver — who died last week a few days after an alleged assault at his auto wreckers — have paid tribute to an “absolute character” with a “heart of gold”.

item.title: Cue beaut cafe up for grabs in the Murchison with unique opportunity
item.description: Hospitality, heritage and jobs in the Mid West boosted by Regional Economic Development grants.

item.title: Geraldton softball round 8: Rams sides produce clinical victories, as women edge closer to top spot
item.description: Rams continued their winning ways in the Geraldton softball women’s division one competition, with the side securing a confident win over Suiside as they pursue first spot on the ladder.

item.title: Carols by Candlelight at Geraldton’s Maitland Park brings community together
item.description: Joy and unity was the message of Sunday’s Carols by Candlelight event, organised by the Geraldton Christian Churches.

item.title: Mid West health professionals recognised for work, named as finalists in WA Rural Health Excellence Awards
item.description: Three Mid West health professionals have been recognised for their work and dedication, named as finalists in the 2026 WA Rural Health Excellence Awards.

item.title: Buccaneers’ under-19 boys division 3 team clinches Geraldton’s second State Basketball Championships title
item.description: Geraldton’s oldest side in the Basketball WA State Championships joins its youngest side as State champions, after securing the title in a thrilling three-point decider on Saturday in Perth.

item.title: Geraldton’s Marine Terrace to be decked in holiday cheer for Christmas celebrations
item.description: Geraldton city centre will become a festive wonderland this week

item.title: Mid West residents should have water ready for bushfires and cyclones
item.description: The Water Corporation is urging Mid West residents to prepare for the upcoming season of severe weather by having sufficient water supplies in their homes, and an action plan in place.

item.title: Soft cap introduced for Regional Airfare Zone Cap Scheme, with higher rates for high-demand flights
item.description: Mid West residents could face a $130 increase for a return fare to Perth as the rules were softened this week under a five-year extension to the Regional Airfare Zone Cap Scheme.
